# Parameters

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · class

```csharp
public sealed class Parameters
```

The parameters of an action or condition, as written in the automation (for example `drive: "E:"`). Values have already been checked against the fields the component declares, so a required field is always there and has the declared type.

Values arrive as JSON: text, numbers, `true`/`false` and lists of text. Durations are text such as `30s`, `1h30m` or `500ms`; times of day are text such as `22:00`.
